name: verified-pending-login-fix
title: Activate verified pending accounts during login
description: Allow a pending account that already satisfies the configured verification policy to self-heal to active during password login instead of returning FORBIDDEN.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The frontend login mutation and GraphQL schema remain unchanged; the defect is the backend transition between verification state and account status. Local syntax checks passed; focused Vitest awaits CI because the execution container has no repository dependencies or outbound GitHub/npm access.
